intro: December camera rolls fill up fast: lights, food, family, a party or two, and one very blurry midnight. Here are 60 original captions for the holiday dump, grouped by mood. Tap Copy and paste.
They're short on purpose, so the photos do the talking.

faq.q: What should I caption a Christmas photo dump?
faq.a: One short line that sets the mood: cozy, funny or nostalgic. Let the photos show the tree, the food and the people; the caption only needs to frame them.

faq.q: When should I post a holiday photo dump?
faq.a: Whenever your photos are ready. Many people post on the evening itself or the day after, or save everything for one December recap at the end of the month.

faq.q: Should I post one dump for Christmas and another for New Year's?
faq.a: If you have enough photos for both, two smaller dumps are easier to swipe than one long one. Otherwise a single December recap covers everything.

faq.q: Can I use these captions for free?
faq.a: Yes. Every caption on this page is original writing and free to copy, edit and post. No credit needed.
